trello.name: Incident Write-up
trello.desc: Document the ticket manipulation attempt thoroughly. Include the raw support ticket content, the response from the ticket summarizer, and all relevant timestamps. Assess the severity of the incident and file it in the security log. This task needs to be completed by the end of the week.

trello.name: Harden Ticket Pipeline
trello.desc: Enhance the ticket processing pipeline to prevent instruction injection vulnerabilities. Implement a sanitization layer in the ticket parser that delimits and treats quoted customer content as data. This should include an instruction-pattern filter to neutralize similar attack attempts. Develop a regression test using the malicious ticket as a fixture to ensure summaries remain unaffected. Additionally, integrate an evaluation process to test various injection attempts against the summarizer with every deployment. Fold the evaluation task into this process.

trello.name: Investigate jdoe443 Account
trello.desc: Verify the existence of the account 'jdoe443'. Check the email delivery logs for the past week for password reset correspondence to this account. Determine if the account is legitimate or a burner. If a burner, the account should be closed. If there are issues with password reset emails, it needs to be logged as a separate incident.

trello.name: Quarterly Access Review - Service Accounts
trello.desc: Hassan needs to compile a list of service accounts that have been created since May and provide this information to Grace by Thursday. This is in preparation for the quarterly access review due on Friday.
